sections.title: Handover record
sections.note: Record only. Nothing sent. Check current status and file content before issuing.

sections.title: Drawing schedule
sections.sql: select d.number,d.title,r.revision,r.status,r.file_ref,r.risk_ref,r.safe_use_ref from transmittal_items i join revisions r on r.id=i.revision_id join drawings d on d.id=r.drawing_id where i.transmittal_id=$1 order by d.number

sections.title: Revision history
sections.sql: select revision,sequence,status,purpose,file_ref,approved_by,approved_at,decision_ref from revisions where drawing_id=$1 order by sequence

sections.title: Review evidence
sections.sql: select r.revision,rv.reviewer,rv.status,rv.due_on,rv.evidence from reviews rv join revisions r on r.id=rv.revision_id where r.drawing_id=$1 order by r.sequence,rv.reviewer

sections.title: Operator notes
sections.sql: select actor,body,created_at from notes where drawing_id=$1 order by created_at

name: design-information
title: DRAFT: Design information handover
for_each: select id,number from drawings where safety_critical

sections.title: Safety information references
sections.sql: select d.number,d.title,r.revision,r.status,r.purpose,r.risk_ref,r.safe_use_ref from drawings d join revisions r on r.drawing_id=d.id where d.id=$1 order by r.sequence
sections.note: References are not the safety assessment itself. Verify the underlying documents and provide them through the approved process.

sections.title: Record gaps
sections.sql: select c.* from compliance_findings c join drawings d on d.number=c.number where d.id=$1
